displayProperties.description: Things didn't get interesting until the first apology.
displayProperties.name: Implement of Curiosity

items.name: Anti-Barrier Hand Cannon
items.description: Your equipped Hand Cannons fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

items.name: Anti-Barrier Sniper Rifle
items.description: Your equipped Sniper Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

items.name: Overload Pulse Rifle
items.description:
Your equipped Pulse Rifles fire disrupting rounds which stun the target, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

items.name: Overload Submachine Gun
items.description:
Your equipped Submachine Guns fire disrupting rounds which stun the target, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

items.name: Unstoppable Bow
items.description: Crossbows, and Bows that have been fully drawn for a short time, fire a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

items.name: Impact, Shock, Gravity
items.description:
Grants access to the Helmet mods: Kinetic/Void Siphon and Kinetic/Arc Siphon.

These mods combine two elemental siphons at a discounted cost.

items.name: Gravitic-Voltaic Charge
items.description: While you have an Arc or Void Super equipped, increase the maximum number of stacks of Armor Charge you can carry by 1.

items.name: Expert Handling
items.description: Weapon final blows grant a stacking bonus to stability which resets on weapon reload or stow. Swords gain Guard Resistance.

items.name: Fastest Draw
items.description: If the first shot shortly after reloading or readying your weapon is a precision hit, gain flinch resistance.

items.name: Elemental Siphon
items.description: Rapid final blows with a Kinetic weapon or a weapon matching your equipped Super create an elemental pickup that matches your equipped Super.

items.name: Press The Advantage
items.description: Breaking a combatant's shield grants increased weapon stability, handling, and reload speed. Swords gain increased guard resistance.

items.name: Kinetic Synthesis
items.description: Sustained Kinetic weapon damage and rapid final blows have a chance to generate a unique ammo brick. Collecting this brick will grant ammo to equipped Kinetic damage weapons and grant Special and Heavy ammo progress.

items.name: Reload at Range
items.description: Precision hits with Bows and Sniper Rifles grant a stacking bonus to their reload speed.

items.name: Riposte
items.description: Shortly after guarding with a Sword, your light and heavy attacks stun unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

items.name: Power from Pain
items.description: Rapid final blows against weakened combatants grant you Devour.

items.name: Dielectric
items.description:
Defeating [Arc]Arc debuffed targets grants Bolt Charge.

Rapidly defeating Arc debuffed targets spawns an Orb of Power and heals a small portion of health.

items.name: Armorsmith
items.description: Breaking a combatant's shield temporarily grants you damage resistance and increased melee damage.

items.name: Counter Energy
items.description: When you or a member of your fireteam stuns a champion, you gain energy for your least-charged ability.

items.name: Combination Argent Blade
items.description: Briefly pause after executing a light attack, then follow it up with a light or heavy attack to empower your Sword for a short time, granting it bonus damage and charge rate.

items.name: Singularity Blade
items.description: While you have a Void elemental buff, melee and Sword hits weaken targets, while melee and Sword final blows create a weakening burst.

items.name: Elemental Orbs: Arc
items.description: [Arc]Arc weapon final blows have a chance to spawn an Arc Elemental Orb. Arc Orbs can be thrown or shot to create an Arc explosion that jolts targets it damages.

items.name: Kinetic Rupture
items.description: Kinetic weapon damage against a powerful combatant has a chance to create a Kinetic Rupture. Targeting this Rupture causes a damaging explosion that staggers combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

items.name: Sniper's Meditation
items.description: Sniper Rifle hits grant stacking Sniper Rifle damage, stability, and reload bonuses for a short time. Heavy ammo Sniper Rifle hits count as more than one hit.

items.name: Sword Storm Combo
items.description: Performing three Sword light attacks followed by a heavy attack summons penumbral blades that surround you to damage and disorient combatants. Sword final blows extend the duration of these penumbral blades.

items.name: Void Infestation
items.description: Defeating a weakened target spawns a tracking projectile that weakens other targets.
